title: Digital Marketing Executive
description:
Digital Marketing Executive
Hybrid role, Salary up to 30,000 DOE. January 2027 Start
Creideas is recruiting for an exciting new opportunity with a Chesterfield based, Civil Engineering client. This role is perfect for a proactive, commercially minded marketer who is eager to learn, take ownership and turn their ideas into action while developing their career

The Role:
In this role you will play a key role in developing and delivering the marketing plan, managing a variety of marketing, digital, PR and social media activities to raise the profile of the business. Working closely with the wider marketing team and Business Development Directors, you will create engaging content, identify promotional opportunities, and help showcase the business, its people and services.
Key Responsibilities:
You will take ownership of a varied, hands-on marketing role, deliver the marketing plan and manage a wide range of activities to raise the profile of the business. This will include:
- Managing and developing the company social media channels, creating engaging content, running campaigns and monitoring performance.
- Maintaining and developing the company website, including SEO and content optimisation.
- Coordinating PR, advertising and editorial activity to maximise brand awareness and media exposure.
- Creating and managing a variety of marketing materials, including case studies, brochures, presentations, videos and digital content.
- Developing email marketing campaigns and maintaining GDPR-compliant marketing databases.
- Coordinating photography, video content, events, and promotional merchandise.
- Keeping up to date with market trends, industry developments, and competitor activity.
- Working closely with the wider marketing team and business development colleagues to identify opportunities, share ideas and support business growth.

Working pattern:
This is a hybrid role, working Monday to Friday 9am-5pm, 3 days in the Chesterfield office and 2 days from home

The individual
- Previous marketing experience, ideally within the construction or a related industry.
- Experience in video production, editing and video marketing.
- Strong written communication, proofreading, and presentation skills.
- Good organisational and interpersonal skills, with excellent attention to detail.
- Experience using marketing metrics and analytics to measure and report on campaign performance.
- A proactive, enthusiastic, and self-motivated approach, with the ability to use initiative.
- A genuine passion for marketing and an interest in the construction sector.
- A confident team player who can also work independently and take ownership of tasks.

This is an excellent opportunity for an ambitious marketing professional looking to take the next step in their career, broaden their experience and develop their skills within a varied, hands-on role. If you're creative, proactive, and keen to make a real impact within a growing business, we'd love to hear from you!

title: European eCommerce Account Manager
description:
SC Johnson Professional have an exciting opportunity for a European eCommerce Account Manager to join the team! You will join us on a full-time, permanent basis, and in return, you will receive a competitive salary.

Location: Denby, Derbyshire
Function: Sales
Internal Job Title: Senior Associate, eCommerce Sales Account Management

About us:

Joining the team at SC Johnson Professional makes you part of a family company with a deep history in the professional market as a leading manufacturer of skincare, cleaning and hygiene products, and smart technologies. We provide solutions to Healthcare, Clean Industrial, Industrial, Office & Institutional, Hospitality & Travel, and Retail & Entertainment markets.

SC Johnson Professional is a business unit within SC Johnson, a family-owned and led company and leading manufacturer of quality, trusted products since 1886.

What s in it for you?
- Competitive salary plus bonus
- Medical Insurance
- 4+1 hybrid working model
- Company pension scheme (up to 6% employer contributions)
- Life assurance (4 your salary)
- Free access to a healthcare platform offering nutritional advice, wellbeing support, and more
- Enhanced parental leave policy
- Free optical vouchers
- 25 days annual leave plus statutory bank holidays
- Remote work available once a week for eligible employees
- Summer office hours: early Friday finish at 1:00 PM
- Employee benefits platform with discounts & wellbeing perks
- Access to employee assistance programmes
- Complimentary fresh fruit & hot drinks
- Subsidised on-site canteen
- Discounted products at our staff shop
- Free parking
- EV charging points at our Denby site (powered by our own renewable electricity!)
- Cycle-to-work scheme plus bicycle storage area
- Save a Space £200 monthly prize draw (earn a ticket every day you car share or don t use a parking space!)
- And so much more!

About the European eCommerce Account Manager role:

We re looking for a proactive and commercially minded European eCommerce Executive to help drive the growth of our eCommerce business across Europe.

Reporting to the European eCommerce Manager, you ll play a key role in bringing our eCommerce strategy to life, supporting day-to-day performance, identifying new growth opportunities and expanding our presence across European markets and online marketplaces.

Working closely with Sales, Marketing, Supply Chain, Finance and external partners, you ll help optimise our online performance, support new product and customer launches, and turn commercial insights into action. This is a great opportunity to gain exposure to multiple European markets, take ownership of key eCommerce activities and contribute to the continued growth of our digital business.

Responsibilities as our European eCommerce Account Manager:
- Support the execution of the European eCommerce strategy, contributing to sales, profitability and growth targets.
- Manage day-to-day Amazon operations, including assortment, content, pricing, availability and promotions, acting as a key point of contact for Amazon stakeholders.
- Drive retail readiness, catalogue quality and digital shelf optimisation in collaboration with our eCommerce agency partner.
- Support pricing strategy, annual negotiations and the execution of agreed commercial plans.
- Analyse key eCommerce performance metrics, including sales, traffic, conversion, availability and Buy Box performance, translating insights into actionable improvements.
- Support eCommerce growth plans across priority European markets, including France, Germany and Spain.
- Coordinate with Supply Chain, Marketing, Customer Service and Finance to improve product availability, resolve operational challenges and ensure smooth execution.
- Support forecasting, promotional planning, peak trading periods and new product launches to maximise commercial opportunities.

Experience you ll bring as our European eCommerce Account Manager:
- Bachelor s or Master s degree in Business, Marketing, Economics or a related field, or equivalent relevant experience.
- Experience in eCommerce, Sales, Marketing or a related commercial role, ideally within FMCG or a digital commerce environment.
- Strong analytical skills, with confidence using Excel and eCommerce performance data; experience with Amazon, ideally Vendor Central, or online marketplaces would be an advantage.

Behaviours you ll need:
- Proactive and results-driven: A hands-on approach, taking ownership of tasks and identifying opportunities to improve performance.
- Analytical and organised: A structured, detail-oriented mindset with the ability to manage multiple priorities and turn insights into action.
- Collaborative and curious: Strong communication and teamwork skills, with a willingness to learn and work effectively across different functions and European markets.

Please Note:
- This role is based in the UK, and applicants must have the right to work in the UK.
- We do not provide domestic or international relocation for this role.
- You will be required to work from the office 5 days a week during the 90 days. After this, the arrangement will transition to 4 days in the office and one day working from home each week.

If you feel like you are the right fit for our European eCommerce Account Manager please click 'Apply' now - we'd love to hear from you!

Inclusion & Diversity

We believe Inclusion and Diversity is more than a program. We embed inclusive practices in our day-to-day work, the way we relate to our colleagues, collaborate and make decisions.

We value the collective richness of the differences people bring to the organization, including style, personality, thoughts, race, ethnicity, culture, religion, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, and disability that enables all to bring their full contributions to the organization.

Better Together

At SC Johnson, we believe people achieve their best when they collaborate and work together in person. We value connection to strengthen teamwork, accelerate problem solving, and drive innovation.

title: Marketing and Communication Lead
description:
Marketing and Communication Lead

Salary: 40,000 FTE ( 20,000 actual salary based on 18.5 hours per week)
Hours: 18 hours per week, across 3 days, in person, may include weekends.
Contract: Fixed Term for 2 Years
Location: Creswell and Ilkeston (office-based initially, with scope for hybrid working in the future)

About us

AEM is the leading autism charity across the East Midlands, supporting autistic people and their families through a range of specialist services. We are launching an exciting new social enterprise and are seeking a creative, ambitious, and proactive individual, to lead this marketing and communications activity from the ground up.

This is a unique opportunity to shape and develop the marketing function of a growing venture while helping establish a strong brand presence, engage customers and stakeholders, and drive business growth.

About the Role

As Marketing and Communications Lead, you will take ownership of all marketing and communications activity for our new social enterprise. This is a varied and hands-on role combining strategic planning with content creation and campaign delivery.

Initially, there will be significant "set-up" work as the social enterprise develops. The successful candidate will therefore need to spend time on-site across our Creswell and Ilkeston locations, building relationships, understanding the business, capturing content, and helping shape the organisation's marketing approach.

You will be responsible for developing and delivering a marketing and communications plan, managing digital platforms, creating engaging content, overseeing the website, coordinating events and campaigns, and measuring the impact of marketing activity.

The role is part-time initially and focuses solely on the social enterprise. It does not have responsibility for the wider charity's marketing activities.

Key Responsibilities
- Develop and implement a Marketing and Communications Plan aligned to the social enterprise's objectives.
- Create, manage and deliver engaging content across social media platforms.
- Lead videography projects including filming, editing, directing and production of promotional content.
- Manage and develop the organisation's website, ensuring content remains accurate, relevant and engaging.
- Plan and deliver integrated marketing campaigns to increase awareness, engagement and growth.
- Coordinate marketing activity for events, launches and community engagement initiatives.
- Monitor campaign performance and provide insight-driven recommendations for improvement.
- Build and maintain a consistent brand identity and tone of voice.
- Identify opportunities to grow online audiences and increase engagement.
- Produce marketing materials including digital assets, presentations, promotional literature and communications.
- Work closely with colleagues and stakeholders to gather stories, case studies and content opportunities.
- Ensure all communications accurately reflect the organisation's values and objectives.

About you

We're looking for someone who combines creativity with strategic thinking and is excited by the opportunity to build something new.

You will have:

Proven experience in a marketing, communications or digital marketing role.

Experience managing social media accounts and delivering successful campaigns.

Strong content creation skills across written, visual and video formats.

Experience managing and updating websites.

Excellent videography and editing skills, with proficiency in tools such as Adobe Premiere Pro, CapCut or similar platforms.

Experience creating and implementing marketing or communications plans.

Strong understanding of digital marketing, audience engagement and brand development.

The ability to analyse performance data and use insights to improve results.

Excellent organisational and project management skills.

The confidence to work independently and take ownership of a broad marketing portfolio.

A willingness to work on-site regularly to capture authentic content and support business development activities.

Future Opportunities

This role offers significant potential for growth.

There is scope for hybrid working once the initial set-up phase has been completed.

Subject to the success and growth of the social enterprise, there may be opportunities to increase working hours in the future.

While this position is offered on a two-year fixed-term basis, there is potential for the role to continue beyond this period should the marketing function demonstrate ongoing business need and growth.

What we offer

25 days annual leave plus bank holidays (33 days pro rata)

Extensive induction programme including specialist autism training

Generous occupational sick pay scheme

Free initial DBS check

Employer pension scheme

Flexible working arrangements

Friendly and supportive working environment

Excellent opportunities for professional development and career progression

Employee referral scheme

Access to counselling services

Access to legal and financial wellbeing support
